messages:
jun: AeroSense POC - they rotated a key and now all API calls 401/403 in staging. Started ~09:40 UTC. Can we triage?

hira: can you paste the exact curl + response body? quick checks: org/project binding or scope.

jun: customer pasted: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H \"Authorization: Bearer ak_aero_77\" -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'` -> `{"error":"unauthorized","message":"invalid credentials"}`. no headers.

oscar: found auth log request_id=abc123 for that token. auth: `warn auth: bind_failed token=ak_aero_77 err=org_alias_mismatch tenant=aerosense-us token_org=aerosense`

hira: looks like token bound to `aerosense` slug but their project resolves to `aerosense-us` alias. if header missing, we fallback to token binding which doesn't match.

jun: customer says their corporate edge (CloudEdge) strips custom headers so they can't set `x-rw-org` easily.

ops-bot: automated: token-rotation detected token=ak_aero_77 rotated_by=jun@redwood at 2026-03-21T09:38:10Z.

oscar: two options: 1) issue a short-lived service key allowed_orgs=["aerosense","aerosense-us"] + minimal scopes for POC, or 2) add an alias mapping `aerosense-us -> aerosense` for the POC. security prefers #1.

jae-liz: (ae) quick pricing Q: if they want Dedicated for predictable latency during POC, what's ballpark?

ae-liz: ballpark: Dedicated entry tier starts at $Zk/month (reserved pool + SLA). i'll confirm exact tier/overage details and send formal quote.

jun: another log entry shows a 403 on chat endpoint: `error auth: permission_denied token=ak_aero_77 required_scopes=[generate:chat] token_scopes=[generate:basic]` so scope mismatch too. multi-cause.

hira: create a service key scoped to both `generate:basic` and `generate:chat` and include allowed_orgs for both slugs. deliver via secure channel, TTL 48h. example test curl to validate:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_poc_aero_1" \\n  -H "x-rw-org: aerosense" \\n  -H "x-rw-project: aero-staging" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"probe"}'
```

sec-bot: automated: service-key-created id=sk_poc_aero_1 created_by=oscar@redwood scopes=[generate:basic,generate:chat] allowed_orgs=["aerosense","aerosense-us"] ttl=48h audit_note="poc-aerosense temp key"

oscar: delivered the key via secure note. asked them to test and post request_id.

jun: customer tested and returned request_id=abc124 with HTTP 200. they asked how to safely cleanup after POC.

ohira: recommend rotate+revoke old key immediately, set TTL on temp key, and add audit entry. advise not to embed keys in client apps; use backend token exchange for mobile.

oscar: i'll schedule revocation in 72h and tag the ticket `poc-aerosense` for easy rollback audit.

ae-liz: i'll follow up on Dedicated quote and security/compliance answers (scope/org restrictions) in an email.

jun: closing auth swarm for now, thanks all. :thumbsup:
